parameters.description: The complete set of tags the inquiry should end up with. Anything left out is removed; leave this blank to leave the tags alone.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: The person's first name, pre-filled into the inquiry.
parameters.name: name_first

parameters.description: The person's middle name.
parameters.name: name_middle

parameters.description: The person's last name.
parameters.name: name_last

parameters.description: The person's email address.
parameters.name: email_address

parameters.description: The person's phone number.
parameters.name: phone_number

parameters.description: The person's date of birth.
parameters.name: birthdate

parameters.description: The first line of the person's address.
parameters.name: address_street_1

parameters.description: The second line of the person's address.
parameters.name: address_street_2

parameters.description: The person's city.
parameters.name: address_city

parameters.description: The person's state or province. In the US, write it out in full rather than abbreviating it.
parameters.name: address_subdivision

parameters.description: The person's postal or ZIP code.
parameters.name: address_postal_code

parameters.description: The person's country as a two-letter ISO code, such as US.
parameters.name: address_country_code

behaviors.description: Risk signals, surfaced to enterprise accounts. The individual keys are not enumerated in the public reference.

failed-at.description: Set when the inquiry failed. A declined inquiry carries completed-at instead.

fields.description: The data collected by the inquiry, as name to {"type", "value"} pairs. Which names appear depends on the inquiry template, and these keys are not key-inflected.

status.description: Where the inquiry has got to. Documented values are created, pending, completed, expired, failed, needs_review, approved and declined; Persona may add more without notice.

inquiry_status.description: Where the inquiry has got to.

status.description: Status of the action execution ("success" on success).

updated_fields.description: The names of the fields that were changed.

description: Run identity verification with Persona: create inquiries, send people the link, read the result, and approve or decline.
